description: Behavioral pattern detection rules for WineShield's behavior analyzer
note: All thresholds reference values from config/default_policy.json

patterns.name: Ransomware — Rapid File Write
patterns.description: Detects rapid mass file writes characteristic of ransomware encrypting files
patterns.false_positive_mitigation: Large file extractions and compilations may trigger this

patterns.name: Ransomware — Mass File Rename
patterns.description: Detects mass file renames followed by writes, characteristic of ransomware encryption

patterns.name: Keylogger — X11 Keyboard Grab
patterns.description: Detects repeated X11 keyboard state queries typical of keyloggers
patterns.note: Full protection requires Xephyr layer enabled

patterns.name: Network Worm — Connection Spray
patterns.description: Detects rapid connections to many unique IPs, characteristic of worm propagation

patterns.name: Data Exfiltration — Read then Send
patterns.description: Detects sensitive file reads followed immediately by large network sends

patterns.name: Privilege Escalation — ptrace Attempt
patterns.description: Detects attempts to use ptrace on non-child processes
patterns.note: ptrace is blocked in Balanced and Strict seccomp modes

patterns.name: Privilege Escalation — Kernel Module Load
patterns.description: Detects attempts to load kernel modules

patterns.name: C2 Beaconing — Periodic Connection
patterns.description: Detects periodic connections to the same external host at regular intervals

patterns.name: Process Injection — Cross-Process Memory
patterns.description: Detects process_vm_readv/writev which can inject into other processes

patterns.name: Suspicious — Executable Memory Mapping
patterns.description: Detects mmap with PROT_EXEC outside known Wine DLL loading patterns
